trap.label: step down from
trap.wrong: She stepped down of her post last week.
trap.right: She stepped down from her post last week.
trap.why: Em português usamos “renunciar a/de”. O aluno copia de. Em inglês, step down from um cargo ou step down as + função.

fix.wrong: The leader stepped down the post.
fix.right: The leader stepped down from the post.

fix.wrong: He was ask to step down.
fix.right: He was asked to step down.

fix.wrong: The deal was fail and the leader stepped down.
fix.right: The deal failed and the leader stepped down.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com as: “He resigned from the position of chairman.” (stepped down as)
Passiva: “They asked her to step down.”
rewrite.answer: She was asked to step down.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com stepped down from: “He left his post.”
rewrite.answer: He stepped down from his post.
